title: Expectation of a product under independent sampling
statement: Let $I$ be a finite index set, let $A_i$ be a finite set with probability mass function $p_i$ for each $i\in I$, and let $q_i:A_i\to\mathbb{R}$. For any subset $S\subseteq I$, the expectation under the independent product distribution of $\prod_{i\in S}q_i(X_i)$ equals $\prod_{i\in S}\mathbb{E}_{X_i\sim p_i}[q_i(X_i)]$.
hypotheses_covered: A probability mass function on each coordinate set
A real-valued function on each coordinate set
A finite subset of the index set
